stem:
Jana is ordering a one-topping pizza. She can choose pepperoni or sausage for her topping and can choose thin, thick, or stuffed crust.

Complete the table to show all possible one-topping pizzas she can order.
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box in the table. Each answer may be used more than once. Not all answers will be used.
response_template:
| Pizza | Topping    | Crust   |
|-------|------------|---------|
| 1     | [blank_1]  | Thin    |
| 2     | Sausage    | Thin    |
| 3     | Pepperoni  | Stuffed |
| 4     | [blank_2]  | Stuffed |
| 5     | Pepperoni  | [blank_3] |
| 6     | [blank_4]  | Thick   |
visual_elements: table with pizza numbers 1 to 6 and columns for Topping and Crust, some cells blank indicated for drag and drop
